hooks.name: Block secrets in git commits
hooks.description: Pre-commit check that blocks git commits containing private keys or secrets in staged files.

action.command: cd /Users/udingethe/Dev/kleros && git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -lE "(0x[a-fA-F0-9]{64}|PRIVATE_KEY\s*=\s*0x|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,})" 2>/dev/null && echo "BLOCKED: Secrets detected in staged files" >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
